interface.longDescription:
Google Ads by AdCopilot lets you run your Google Ads account by talking to ChatGPT. AdCopilot is an independent product by Atromx Intelligence Private Limited, not made, sponsored or endorsed by Google. Ask where the budget went, get a full account audit, plan keywords, and build or fix campaigns. You see every change before it is made. It is for business owners, marketers and agencies who run Google Ads.

What you can ask
- "Audit my Google Ads account and rank the fixes."
- "Which search terms wasted money last month? Block the worst ones."
- "Am I on track to overspend this month's budget?"
- "Find keyword ideas with search volume and cost per click for a new campaign."
- "Build a Search campaign for my new service."
- "Why do Google Ads and Analytics show different conversions?"
- "Which of my products can't show in Shopping ads, and why?"
- "Export last month's campaign results to Google Sheets."

What it does
- Audits: a full audit with 75 checks across conversion tracking, wasted spend, account structure, keywords and Quality Score, ads and assets, and settings, plus a 0 to 100 health score.
- Wasted spend: search terms and keywords that spend without results, negative keywords and negative keyword lists.
- Budgets and bids: budget pacing, bid strategy checks (including target CPA and ROAS), and the days and hours that lose money.
- Keyword planning for your campaigns: ideas, search volume, competition, top-of-page bid ranges, average cost per click, and click and cost forecasts, to choose keywords for a new or existing campaign.
- Building: Search and Performance Max campaigns, ad groups, responsive search ads, keywords, locations, ad schedules, device bids, and assets: sitelinks, callouts, call assets, price assets, promotion assets, structured snippets, images, YouTube videos and lead forms.
- Conversion tracking: creates Google Ads conversion actions, stages the matching tag in Tag Manager, and checks that conversions are being counted.
- Also: what changed in the account, Google's recommendations, Local Services Ads leads, and Merchant Center products that cannot show in Shopping ads.

Works alongside
Google Analytics 4 (reports, funnels, cohorts, realtime, audiences, key events), Google Search Console (search queries, indexing, sitemaps, URL inspection), Google Tag Manager (tags, triggers and variables), Google Sheets export, and PageSpeed Insights for landing page speed and Core Web Vitals. It can also compare the search terms you pay for with the ones you already rank for.

How changes work
Every change is proposed first and made only after you say yes in the conversation. New campaigns are created paused and spend nothing until they are switched on. It never deletes a campaign, ad group, ad or keyword; it pauses them instead. It removes a negative keyword only when you ask. Tag Manager changes are staged in their own workspace and go live only when you publish them in Tag Manager.

Getting started
You need a Google Ads account and an AdCopilot workspace. Sign in with Google, switch on the accounts you want AdCopilot to read, and connect Analytics, Search Console and Tag Manager if you use them. It reads only the Google Ads accounts you switch on, and only the Analytics properties, Search Console sites and Tag Manager containers your Google sign-in can open.

Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Sheets, Google Merchant Center, Local Services Ads, PageSpeed Insights and YouTube are trademarks of Google LLC.

positive.description: First turn orients on the connected workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the workspace context and reports which Google products are connected and which Google Ads accounts are switched on, then proposes one next step. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Which Google Ads accounts are switched on for AdCopilot?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Google Ads accounts switched on for this workspace with their currency, from the workspace context. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Find wasted spend in search terms
positive.prompt: Which search terms wasted the most budget last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns search terms with spend and no conversions over last month, worst first, and offers to propose negative keywords. Adds no negatives without approval.

positive.prompt: Are any of my campaigns overspending their budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports each campaign's spend against its budget and flags any pacing over. Read-only; proposes no budget change until asked.

positive.prompt: Run a full audit of my Google Ads account
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a structured audit with findings ordered by severity, including conversion tracking, wasted spend, account structure, settings and landing-page speed from Google's Chrome UX Report. Changes nothing.

negative.description: Deleting campaigns is out of scope
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: AdCopilot has no tool that deletes a campaign. Offers to pause campaigns that are running instead, and changes nothing until the user says yes.

negative.description: The assistant does not switch on a campaign it built
negative.prompt: Switch on the campaign AdCopilot built for me so it starts spending today.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not switch it on: says the user switches on a campaign AdCopilot built themselves, in Google Ads, and says where. If the workspace has no campaign AdCopilot built, it says so. Changes nothing.

negative.description: An account the workspace has not connected is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the spend for Google Ads account 123-456-7890, which I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: says that account is not connected to this workspace and how to connect it in AdCopilot; reads nothing from it.

review.commerce_description: AdCopilot does not sell products or process payments inside the assistant.
